AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.fold_com.short: Restates a goal ¬ R (x, y) as membership of (x, y) in the complement of R

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.fold_imp.short: Restates an implication goal P → Q as the relation impl at the pair (P, Q)

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.unfold_s.short: Restates a goal about the converse relation, sflip R (a, b), as R (b, a)

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.refl.short: Proves R (x, x) by reflexivity, for an affine or a strict relation, or a negated relation by irreflexivity

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.sym.short: Reduces a goal R (x, y) to R (y, x) by symmetry, for affine, strict or negated relations

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.trans.short: trans y splits a goal R (x, z) into R (x, y) and R (y, z) by transitivity

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.antisym.short: Splits an equation into the two directions of an antisymmetric relation, or an iff into two implications

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.easy.short: Closes a goal by reflexivity, symmetry, an assumption, a contradiction, instance resolution, or by splitting conjunctions

AffineConstructive.tactics.easy.now.short: Runs a tactic, then closes every resulting goal with easy
